# [Baseline] - IOS - D - Defender for Endpoint Onboarding Unsupervised

Onboards Microsoft Defender for Endpoint without user action on unsupervised enrolled devices via Defender's local loopback VPN, which provides web protection without sending traffic off the device.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | iOS/iPadOS |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Device config |
| Assignment | — |
| checkId | none — the platform engine has no matcher for this policy type |
| Source | UniFy iOS/iPadOS Baseline v1.2 — DC - Zero-Touch-Onboarding-VPN - MDE - BYOD Devices (iosVpnConfiguration: customVpn com.microsoft.scmx, server 127.0.0.1, SilentOnboard and SingleSignOn); fields verified against Graph beta iosVpnConfiguration and pl4nty DCv1 |
| File | [`Baseline_IOS_D_Defender_for_Endpoint_Onboarding_Unsupervised.json`](Baseline_IOS_D_Defender_for_Endpoint_Onboarding_Unsupervised.json) |

> disableOnDemandUserOverride=true: the user cannot turn off 'Connect On Demand'. Microsoft specifically mentions turning it off as the solution for apps that do not work with a VPN — such a user can then only be helped by excluding them from this policy. iOS supports only one active device-wide VPN at a time (Microsoft Learn); a second VPN profile on the same device alternates with this profile. Do not assign together with the Supervised variant.
